entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1625209684868707328: position at J2016.0. Distance: Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 148387: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 35.42 +/- 0.09 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b): 28.233 +/- 0.072 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 35.7163 +/- 0.2829 mas (same row, RUWE 3.71), 126.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -16.394, 57.094 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1625209684868707328 (quality A), from 2018A&A...616A...7S; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 10.53 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 148387: radius 10.53 +/- 0.04 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 3.47 +/- 0.01 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b). Mass 2.45 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 148387: mass 2.45 +/- 0.1 solar masses (Table 6), from the PARAM Bayesian fit to PARSEC isochrones at the measured temperature; the paper calls its masses estimates only (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa9d8b). Temperature 5060 +/- 64 K from Baines et al. (2018), AJ 155, 30, HD 148387: effective temperature 5060 +/- 64 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Eta Draconis is HR 6132., cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 754: HR 6132; VizieR III/202 (2 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe9cd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 148387 is not in the library; kiehling: HR 6132 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 6132 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,060 K and log g 2.78 (u1 0.612, u2 0.160): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
